The Sword in the Stone was released.

12-26.t: The Disney studio began its move from Hyperion Avenue to Burbank.
The Art of Self Defense was released.

12-27.t: Time put Walt Disney on the Cover of its Weekly News Magazine.

12-28.t: Man and the Moon debuted on TV.
Ashley Brown led Mary Poppins Themed master class.

12-29.t: Character Actor Otis Harlan, the Voice of Happy in Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, was born.
Beaver Valley & Cameras in Africa debuted on TV.

12-30.t: Raymond Disney, Walt's Brother, was born.

12-31.t: The Computer Wore Tennis Shoes was released.
New Year Countdown Fireworks opened at Hollywood Studios.
